Day 1 in Porto — Vila Nova de Gaia and the river
Walk the Gaia riverfront first. The postcard view of Ribeira is free from this side.
Book one port wine cellar with a tasting. Walk-ins in July–September often mean an hour in a queue.
Eat off the front row of Ribeira unless you want to pay twice for the same view.

Day 2 in Porto — historic centre, one hill, one market
São Bento station hall: fifteen minutes, then leave.
Clérigos, Cedofeita or Miguel Bombarda if you want streets that still work as a city.
